sources.title: Gemma 4 12B: The Developer Guide - Google Developers Blog
sources.snippet: Meet Gemma 4 12B: the first medium-sized, encoder-free multimodal model capable of natively ingesting audio and video. Ideal for local AI development with 16GB VRAM, Hugging Face integrations, and drop-in local API servers.
